newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-GRAF KNEE EXAMINATION MAY DECIDE COMEBACK.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF KNEE EXAMINATION MAY DECIDE COMEBACK.

text.p: Steffi Graf, out of action for more than a month with a knee injury, will undergo an examination this week or next, a spokesman for the player said on Tuesday.
Graf is set to be replaced as world number one by Switzerland's Martina Hingis on March 31 after a total of 377 weeks at the top.
Graf, world number one since June 12, 1995, is hoping to make a comeback at the end of April in the German Open tournament in Hamburg.
"But even that can really be decided only after her next (knee) examination," her spokesman Pascal Zimmer said.
"Her left knee will be examined at the end of this week or the beginning of next week and then we will know more."
Graf, 27, has not played since the semifinals of a tournament in Tokyo on February 1.
She has trained a little since then. Doctors have told her not to do anything too strenuous or put too much strain on her knee.
